name: Determine whether tote-exchange and sorter stoppage is associated with XLE communication loss, an abnormal RMS task state, or S-Tunnel communication errors
description: A diagnostic procedure for determining whether tote-exchange and sorter stoppage is associated with XLE communication loss, an abnormal RMS task state, or S-Tunnel communication errors.
when_to_use: Before escalating a tote-exchange or sorter-stoppage issue, compare observations across the RMS / fleet status UI, Ignition gateway, and S-Tunnel / Chat path to distinguish XLE communication loss, abnormal RMS task state, or S-Tunnel communication errors.

Before escalating a tote-exchange or sorter-stoppage issue, inspect the RMS / fleet status UI at UPS Haslet TX (TXRTH) for current robot status, current task data, and the displayed tote-exchange or bag-out operating state, then compare observations across the RMS / fleet status UI, Ignition gateway, and S-Tunnel / Chat path to distinguish XLE communication loss, abnormal RMS task state, or S-Tunnel communication errors.
not_for: Modify firewall or service configuration during this diagnostic procedure.

name: Record AGV fault/crash status and displayed task counts
description: A user records whether AGVs are reported as faulted or crashed, along with the displayed canceled and received task counts.

name: Check Ignition gateway Systems Overview or status view for lost communication to XLEs
description: A user checks the Ignition gateway Systems Overview or status view for a current or recent message stating lost communication to XLEs.
when_to_use: When verifying XLE connectivity, inspect the source-documented connectivity results for documented XLE targets on port 42400; do not rely on OCR-uncertain endpoint values.

name: Record reported scanner or sorter communication inability
description: Users record whether scanners or the sorter are reported as unable to communicate with the system.
